quests.title: Adventure Takes Courage!

dialogue.t: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.
Greetings. You both look great today. Are you here to take commissions or deal with other affairs?
Why are you both staring at me? Is there something of significance that you would like to inquire about?

dialogue.sit: W—We just want to take commissions...

dialogue.t: Understood. You seem like a seasoned adventurer already.
Then you must be well acquainted with the Adventurers' Guild's way of operation. Therefore, I won't waste your time going over it.
If you have any questions for the Guild, please feel free to ask me at any time.
Please pitch in with the commissions in Sumeru City. Outstanding adventurers like you will surely be a great help to the people here.
Safe travels, Traveler. Ad astra abyssosque!

quests.description: You find a familiar place in Sumeru City…
